acquisition method: using “top 10” data dependent acquisition with a 60 millisecond fill time
alkylation reagent: treated with 50 mM chloroacetamide in UA buffer for 20 minutes in the dark
alkylation concentration: treated with 50 mM chloroacetamide in UA buffer
cleavage agent: subsequently digested with endoproteinase Glu-C for 16 hours in 50 μl IP buffer at 20°C
enrichment method: Peptides containing diGly-Lys were enriched with anti-K GG
fractionation method: fractionated by protein electrophoresis and the gel was cut into nine slices
instrument: analysed by liquid chromatography tandem MS on a Q Exactive mass spectrometer
ionization type: coupled to an EASY-nLC 1000 liquid chromatography system (Thermo Scientific) via an EASY-Spray ion source
labeling: analysed by liquid chromatography tandem MS on a Q Exactive mass spectrometer
reduction reagent: lysis buffer (6 M guanidinium-HCl, 100 mM sodium phosphate buffer pH 8.0, 10 mM Tris-HCl, 20 mM imidazole, 5 mM β-mercaptoethanol)
